svg.title: SmartCrib: what the model sees, three one-second windows and the INT8 model's answer
svg.desc: Three public-dataset clips run through the project's own MFCC pipeline and INT8 TensorFlow Lite model: an infant cry from Donate-a-Cry, a dog bark and a vacuum cleaner from ESC-50. Each column shows the 1-second waveform, the 40-frame by 13-coefficient MFCC input as a heatmap (standardized with the training-set statistics the device uses), and the model's P(cry): 0.9961 for the cry, 0.0547 for the dog bark and 0.0000 for the vacuum cleaner, against the 0.7 operating threshold.
svg.text: WHAT THE MODEL SEES · 1 s WINDOW → 40 FRAMES × 13 MFCC → INT8 MODEL → P(CRY)
